plugins.name: dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Personal dev workflow skills: commit hygiene, debugging, dependency audits, doc sync, env checks, SQL review, test generation, and todo sweeps.

plugins.name: knowledge-capture
plugins.description: Capture things you just learned and publish them to Confluence. Bundles the official Atlassian remote MCP server, so it works out of the box for anyone who installs it — first use prompts a one-time OAuth connect via /mcp. Requires Confluence to be provisioned on your Atlassian site.
